Chapter 1075: 16 Lin Yuan Tears The Sky (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3

Chapter 1075: Chapter 16 Lin Yuan Tears the Sky (Seeking Monthly Pass)_3

At this moment, within tens of millions of light years, everything was shrouded beneath Lin Yuan’s internal universe.

“What is this?”

Nine Profound Venerable felt an unprecedented suppression; the originally unstoppable power of the Six Profounds was now completely restrained, shrinking rapidly.

“Suppress.”

Lin Yuan gazed indifferently at Nine Profound Venerable, beginning to mobilize the full force of his external universe to crush him.

Though the power of the external universe was terrifying, its duration was limited, so Lin Yuan did not hold back in the slightest.

“Ahhhh?”

Nine Profound Venerable instantly felt excruciating pain in both his body and soul as an unstoppable, horrifying oppression descended upon him.

Nine Profound Venerable’s physical body began to crumble, inch by inch, and his soul simultaneously started to be annihilated. Under this overwhelming suppression, all of his resistance seemed utterly futile.

Boom. Boom. Boom.

The terrifying suppression continued to descend. The once overwhelmingly formidable Nine Profound Venerable now had his arm crushed, twisted, and shattered. His severed arm flew away, and holes began to appear all over his blood-soaked flesh and skin. Even his internal universe showed signs of collapse.

Nine Profound Venerable staggered backward repeatedly, his expression filled with shock and terror. Without hesitation, he activated a stronger life-saving technique.

“Nine Profound Body Protection.”

Nine entirely new forces collided, forming a barrier around Nine Profound Venerable to resist the horrifying oppression descending from all directions of the Void Domain.

Bang! Bang! Bang!!

Lin Yuan continued to channel the power of his external universe, relentlessly suppressing Nine Profound Venerable. Yet, the protective barrier formed by Nine different forces bent and twisted under the pressure, though it did not completely shatter, steadfastly persisting.

“Troublesome.”

Lin Yuan frowned. Nine Profound Venerable was indeed difficult to deal with—although he was only a newly ascended Venerable, his life-saving trump cards were no weaker than those of powerful veteran Venerables.

It must be noted that within tens of millions of light years, all of it essentially constituted Lin Yuan’s internal universe. In this domain, Lin Yuan’s killing power was so strong that it would make ordinary Venerables’ scalps tingle.

“Only one second left.”

Lin Yuan sensed that the duration of his external universe was about to end.

“Explode!”

Without hesitation, Lin Yuan detonated his external universe.

After all, once the time expired, the external universe would dissipate anyway, so he might as well detonate it to unleash its strongest power.

Rumble.

The surrounding Void began to collapse, and the resulting annihilation force fully engulfed Nine Profound Venerable.

“What is this?”

Nine Profound Venerable’s face turned aghast. Originally, he had been resisting with great difficulty using the life-saving technique of Nine Profound Body Protection, but now he was under even greater pressure, causing immeasurable terror in his heart.

….

All across the Myriad Manifestations Void Domain, various Chaos Venerables continued to observe attentively.

“It seems Nine Profound Venerable and that mysterious Venerable have truly become deadly serious?”

“I wonder what might have triggered such an intense battle between the two Venerables?”

“That mysterious Venerable’s unleashed Void explosion is remarkably lethal.”

“Indeed, it’s likely forcing Nine Profound Venerable to use further trump cards.”

…

The Chaos Venerables engaged in casual conversation, occasionally tossing in a few remarks.

Witnessing the showdown of trump cards between two Chaos Venerables was already a rare occurrence, let alone involving a Venerable they had never heard of before.

…

Crash.

The Void shattered, and chaos split apart.

Within tens of millions of light years, everything was rapidly disintegrating.

Even the Nine Profound Secret Realm in the distance had partially been destroyed. Without the strongest defensive formation at its core, it might have been entirely wiped out.

Lin Yuan stood calmly in the Void, his aura showing some signs of weariness.

Detonating the external universe came at a cost to Lin Yuan himself, though it posed no significant problem—he could recover after resting for a brief time.

Buzz!

At this moment, amidst the collapsing Void, a new aura began to condense and quickly materialize.

“Hahahahahaha.”

Nine Profound Venerable looked utterly battered but showed little diminishment in his aura, laughing exuberantly.

“That move just now—was it your strongest trump card? You can’t use it a second time in the short term, and you’ve also fallen into a weakened state, haven’t you?”

Nine Profound Venerable quickly analyzed Lin Yuan’s state. To endure Lin Yuan’s external universe detonation, he had resorted to activating a life-saving treasure.

It was a treasure, not a technique.

Techniques, once used, could be repeatedly deployed.

But treasures, once expended, were gone forever.

Nine Profound Venerable had already paid a heavy price to stand against Lin Yuan.

“Now, it’s my turn.”

Nine Profound Venerable extended his hand, summoning a monumental strike that descended upon Lin Yuan.

He had no intention of allowing Lin Yuan any chance to recover, planning to fight relentlessly until Lin Yuan conceded.

“Still lacking something.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly as he watched Nine Profound Venerable’s increasingly close attack.

…

A great distance away, beyond layers of time and space.

Cang Yulong was likewise observing the battlefield.

Of course, given his strength, at most, he could sense the waves of conflict. The actual details of the battle were beyond his perception.

But within the depths of Cang Yulong’s consciousness, a young and childlike voice continued “commentating” on the battle for him.

“It’s over. Nine Profound Venerable actually endured? Your senior is about to lose.”

The youthful voice in Cang Yulong’s mind carried a tone of regret.

“Senior is going to lose?”

Cang Yulong was startled, though he had anticipated the possibility, it still left him feeling deeply disappointed.

“It’s normal to lose. After all…”

The childlike voice was just about to console Cang Yulong when, suddenly sensing something, it immediately fell silent.

“After all, what?”

Cang Yulong curiously called out several times, hoping the voice would continue.

But the childlike voice went completely silent, as if it had perished, refusing to say another word.

“Hmm?”

Cang Yulong finally sensed that something was amiss. He raised his head and instinctively glanced around.

That one glance.

Made Cang Yulong’s eyes widen in shock.

Beside him, a figure stood, though he wasn’t sure when the figure had appeared.

The figure belonged to a young man, bearing some resemblance to the senior Cang Yulong had seen earlier.

“Senior, are you not…”

Cang Yulong stared blankly, unsure why his senior, who was currently clashing with Nine Profound Venerable, would appear here.

Cang Yulong faintly realized that the senior before him seemed different from the one he had encountered earlier—his physical presence was vastly more imposing, as if by merely standing there, he could crush space itself.

Cang Yulong opened his mouth, but before he could utter a word.

He saw Lin Yuan lift his right arm, spread his five fingers as though gripping something, and then gently tear toward the Nine Profound Secret Realm.

Crash.

Five incomparably deep and restrained cracks flashed by and disappeared from Cang Yulong’s vision.

Instinctively, upon seeing those five cracks, an unparalleled sense of terror surged within Cang Yulong’s heart.

Outside the Nine Profound Secret Realm.

Nine Profound Venerable was just about to suppress Lin Yuan.

At that moment, Nine Profound Venerable’s pupils shrank as he saw the grab that tore through heaven and all creation.
